modules.name: Cymbolism
modules.description: Physical cymbal: real shell modes computed from the geometry, a nonlinear core for the crash bloom, contact beaters (stick, mallet, rods, brush, bow), rivets, choke and a modelled mic. Ten types from splash to china, nothing sampled

modules.name: Cymbolism Extended
modules.description: The Cymbolism cymbal with the laws of physics on knobs: morph between two types, warp and tune the mode spectrum to scales or chords, sustain and freeze, load, live tension, pump, bounce, rain, stereo mics and extra outputs
